name: Dhruv Patil
headline: PMO / Project Analyst
summary: Analyst with an MSc in Business Analytics (Distinction), including Project Management and Stakeholder Management modules, and hands-on experience turning delivery data into clear reports and Power BI dashboards for managers and clients. I bring careful attention to detail, quality checks on data and documents, and an improvement-focused approach to supporting governance and delivery controls.
